plan.notes: Plan intro states 45 major-specific credits and a 120-credit university minimum. The term layout encodes to 48 credits including the Y4 Spring 'HIST 300 level course [if needed]'; without that conditional course the total is 45, matching the stated requirement. HIST 296 (History Seminar) is listed as a Fall-or-Spring option in Year 2 (take once, either semester); both semesters' choice slots list it as an option and the slots are choice-flagged so the validator's duplicate check does not apply. HIST 398 similarly is a Fall-or-Spring Year 3 option. The 'HIST 100 or 200 level' and 'HIST 300 level' slots are genuine named requirement slots from the plan; student selects specific courses with advisor. Per-slot prereqs are not published on the 4-year plan page; prereq arrays are intentionally empty. Source: official Chapman University 2024-2025 Undergraduate Catalog, '' (Suggested 4-Year Plan). https://catalog.chapman.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=46&poid=9883 The catalog states a minimum of None credits to graduate and None major-specific credits for this degree; the plan page publishes major courses by term only — General Education/minor courses are selected by the student around this plan, so total_credits (48) is the sum of the published major-course slots, not the 120-credit degree minimum. Per-slot prerequisites are not published on the 4-year plan page, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty; see the catalog's course descriptions for official prerequisites. Variable-credit courses are encoded at the source lower bound with the range documented in choice_note.
